what:
## codegen-mir: `tools/v2/hot_lint.py`'s fresh-`Vec` rule matches inside `smallvec![` (2026-10-29)

What: the rule `\bVec::new\(\)|vec!\[|\.to_vec\(\)` (`hot_lint.py:28`) has no word boundary
before `vec!`, so every `smallvec![..]` is reported as a fresh `Vec`, though a `SmallVec` is
what the rule's own message asks for. Seven of the interpreter's per-operation results
(`eval.rs`, `Owned(smallvec![r])` in `eval_rvalue`) and the computed aggregate
(`construct_shadowed`) are reported now that they are inline `SmallVec`s.
Ask: `\bvec!\[` in place of `vec!\[`. While there: `Vec::new()` and `vec![]` allocate nothing
until pushed to, so reporting them (an `Evaluator::new` has 20 such fields) hides the real
`vec![0; n]`s; `vec!\[\]` and `Vec::new\(\)` could leave the rule.
Where: `tools/v2/hot_lint.py:28`.

> forwarded to the coordinator (`tools/`): on requests' coordinator list (requests, pass 22).

history.note: tools/v2/hot_lint.py: Input.crates is tuple[str, ...] (any name under crates/ or a path from the root; a missing crate or a run reading no file exits 2); a test cfg is any predicate only test/fuzz builds set (test, all(test, ..), any(test, feature = "fuzz"), fuzzing); files of out-of-line #[cfg(test)] mod x; (and their submodule dirs) and #[path] sources from tests/ are skipped, as is a file under #![cfg(test)]; comments and string/raw-string/char literals are blanked over the whole file (multi-line too) before both the brace count and the checks; \bvec!\[ so smallvec! is not a fresh Vec; HOT gains vendor/salsa, vendor/salsa-macros, vendor/salsa-macro-rules and fuzz (fuzz/targets stays unread, as tests are), blaze-diagnostics was already in; blaze-tier (no such crate) dropped. Vec::new() and vec![] stay reported: they are where a buffer that later grows is born; justify them or move to a reused buffer.
